title: Unit Event — Parallel Harmonies — Episode2 Two Talents

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need is finally going to start writing its debut song! However, Mr. Shindo has a request: that Saki and Ichika compose it together. The pair are determined to make it a great song, but things don't go so smoothly...

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That was a good meeting.
We got to hear quite a lot of news today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I was wondering which we'd get to hear about, our debut or that festival. I can't believe we got to hear about both!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me neither. Especially when we heard what we'll be doing for our debut single...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: He really wants you and me to write it together, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You want Saki and Ichika to write it together...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Together...? Why is that?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Saki always handles the music...
So, wouldn't it be better to leave that in her hands...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes, I considered that option.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: The public gets its first impression of a band through its debut single. Which is why I thought about having you go with the process you've employed until now.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: But I decided against that. Instead of business as usual, I want you all to show everyone what Leo/need is like after you've reached the next level.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: After we've reached the next level...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Can you elaborate a little further...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: As things currently stand, Leo/need's debut takes first priority over everything else at this company for this part of the fiscal year.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: First priority...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: We plan to inject all our resources into coming up with the best marketing campaign for your band.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Which is why Mr. Shimizu from Starry Music, our parent company, was here. To discuss that very matter.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: In return for receiving a share of the distribution rights to Leo/need's debut single, they've agreed to help us with your marketing campaign.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes, and Mr. Shimizu also holds you in high regard.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Starry Music will be giving you its spot on the digital billboards, as well as funding our ad campaigns centered around social media.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Billboards...! That means...
This is like a super duper huge deal...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes, it is.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: To be honest, I wasn't expecting them to come up with so much money for us.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: But if things go well, your song is going to reach a lot of ears.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: In other words, you'll become household names overnight.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Normally, we'd give a band more time to flesh out their music. And you ladies are still just getting on your feet.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: My original plan was to begin with having you become more experienced by playing shows and releasing more songs. Then, I would've started a big marketing campaign.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: But between the decisions that were made during our meeting the other day and Starry Music agreeing to join us in this endeavor...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I came to believe that now is Leo/need's chance to take on a big challenge such as this.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: The music you've produced up until now has been excellent.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
But I believe you can still go higher.
I want to see Leo/need produce a song that can move the hearts of even more people.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I believe Ms. Tenma and Ms. Hoshino will be able to achieve that by putting their individual talents together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me and Ichi...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Your songs have this warmth to them, Ms. Tenma. It's like you're able to show the listener real empathy.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Your songs, Ms. Hoshino, are a little rough around the edges, but they have this charm to them because of how you always try to make your feelings crystal clear.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Which is where this idea comes from.
If Leo/need is able to join these two pieces in producing music, then I feel that your band is going to sound like it's taken another step forward.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: By doing so, I believe you'll be able to reach more people. In other words, Leo/need's music will be on a whole new level.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Which will surely make your debut single an enormous success.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Our music...? The next level...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I'll look forward to hearing what you come up with.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The next level...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Can we really accomplish that...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We'll be fine, Ichi!
This is us we're talking about!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree. I also believe you two will do just fine.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So do I, but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Compared to Ichika, aren't you being a little too optimistic about this, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. No way!
Ichi and I've got this!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Does that mean you already know what you wanna do?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... Not exactly...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I feel like Ichi and I are unstoppable when we're together!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And it's not like Mr. Shindo would tell us to do this if he didn't think we could handle it, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, true...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And I agree. You and I should do just fine, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Just wait, Shiho, Hona!
We're gonna write the best debut single ever!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, we're counting on you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Good luck.
